_doc: UI-diff cases (tools/ui-diff/README.md). Committed; everything else under ui-ref/ is gitignored (D5). port.frames count 60 Hz fixed frames from power-on (the port boots Boot -> Title with 16-frame fades: Title is visible from ~frame 79; A at 90 -> NewGame -> Overworld visible from ~frame 184); ref.frames count from the savestate load. ref.frames[i] is compared with port.frames[i]; an entry is an int or a [lo, hi] window (best pair counts). ref.inputs is the human's recipe, not executed by code. phash is written by capture_ref.sh.

ref.inputs: load boot.mln (title screen, steady); no input
load overworld.mln (outdoor map, player idle); no input
load overworld.mln; press Start at frame 70
